column1: # Tab-separated, one template per row, after the header row:
# starts and ends are mm-dd, and both days fall inside the window. In a
# template, @ marks where the recipient's display name goes. Templates
# contain no digits, and each one has exactly one @.

column4: @ hangs a paper lantern by the entrance and lights it early.
@ carves a face into the biggest squash at the market and leaves it smiling.
@ reads the old ghost stories aloud while the rain comes in off the river.
@ sets an extra chair at the table, for whoever is still on the way.
@ walks home the long way to see every lit window.
@ chalks the names of the ones who are gone on the step, and stays a while.
